title: What Tracks Hard-Negative Transfer? A Study of Lexical and Semantic Signals
abstract: arXiv:2603.20990v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Which properties of hard-negative supervision track dense-retriever transfer before training? We compare lexical noncoverage, frozenencoder similarity statistics, hardness proxies, and combinations of these signals across BM25, dense, LLM-generated, and hybrid sources for MS MARCO training. Evaluation uses three retriever backbones and eleven BEIR datasets. Mean lexical residuality, an IDF-weighted measure of query-token noncoverage, reproduces the aggregate transfer ordering in all six backbone and setting blocks. The individual semantic statistics recover none of the complete orderings, and combining them with the lexical signal does not improve the observed rank agreement. After approximately matching BM25, dense, and LLM diagnostic samples for lexical residuality, none of the tested semantic statistics recovers the observed LLM > Dense > BM25 transfer ordering across three backbones, three matching resolutions, and 100 repe

translated_title: 是什么在追踪难负样本的迁移效果？一项关于词汇信号与语义信号的研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.20990v5 公告类型： replace-cross。摘要：难负样本监督的哪些属性能够在训练之前预测稠密检索器的迁移表现？我们在MS MARCO训练场景下，跨BM25、稠密检索、LLM生成和混合来源，比较了词汇非覆盖率、冻结编码器相似度统计量、难度代理指标以及这些信号的组合。评估采用三个检索器骨干网络和十一个BEIR数据集。平均词汇残差度——一种基于IDF加权的查询词元非覆盖率度量——在全部六个骨干与设置组合中均重现了聚合迁移排序。单独的语义统计量均无法恢复完整的排序，而将它们与词汇信号结合也不能提升所观察到的排序一致性。在将BM25、稠密和LLM诊断样本的词汇残差度大致匹配后，所测试的语义统计量中没有任何一个能够在三个骨干、三种匹配分辨率和100次重复实验中恢复所观察到的 LLM > Dense > BM25 迁移排序。
tldr: 本研究发现在训练前预测稠密检索器迁移效果时，基于IDF加权的查询词元非覆盖率指标（平均词汇残差度）能够稳定重现难负样本来源的迁移排序，而冻结编码器的各类语义统计量无论单独使用还是与词汇信号结合均无法做到这一点。
en_tdlr: The IDF-weighted lexical noncoverage metric (mean lexical residuality) reliably predicts dense-retriever transfer orderings across hard-negative sources before training, whereas frozen-encoder semantic statistics fail to do so even when combined with the lexical signal.
